en.headline: Police smash Kwun Tong phone fraud centre, arrest 20
en.dek: Officers raided an industrial unit used as a call centre by a local syndicate that posed as debt collectors, linking the group to at least 16 cases and more than HK$1.3 million in losses.
body: Police on Tuesday arrested 20 people after raiding a telephone fraud centre operating from an industrial unit in Kwun Tong, the force said.

East Kowloon crime officers mounted the operation, code-named Ying Wu, against a local syndicate believed to be controlled by triad elements. The group allegedly posed as a debt-collection company, calling victims during office hours and claiming they owed unpaid sums, using intimidation to pressure them into making payments.

Fourteen men and six women aged between 20 and 61 were detained on suspicion of conspiracy to defraud and money laundering. Among them were one alleged mastermind, three staff and multiple mule account holders. Officers seized 12 mobile phones, one tablet and a quantity of SIM cards.

Police said the group was linked to at least 16 telephone fraud cases involving more than HK$1.3 million. The suspects, who claimed to work as clerks, sales staff or to be unemployed, were being held for further inquiries. Investigators said more arrests were possible as they traced the flow of funds.

zh.headline: 警搗觀塘電話騙案中心拘20人 涉至少16宗共130萬元
zh.dek: 東九龍總區突擊搜查觀塘工廈單位，搗破假扮收數公司的本地詐騙集團，拘捕包括主腦在內20人，涉串謀行騙及洗黑錢。
body: 警方周二展開代號「熒霧」行動，突擊搜查觀塘一個工廠大廈單位，搗破一個本地犯罪集團營運的電話詐騙中心，拘捕20名男女。
東九龍總區刑事部表示，集團假扮收數公司，在辦公時間致電受害人，聲稱有未還清款項，利用心理威嚇逼使對方付款。行動檢獲12部手提電話、一部平板電腦及多張電話卡。
被捕的14男6女年齡介乎20至61歲，包括一名集團主腦、三名員工及多名傀儡戶口持有人，涉嫌串謀行騙及洗黑錢。部分人報稱為文員、售貨員或無業。
警方指集團與至少16宗電話騙案有關，涉款超過130萬元，正追查資金去向，不排除有更多人被捕。
